name: MIRAE ASSET Life Insurance Co., Ltd.
summary: MIRAE ASSET Life Insurance Co., Ltd. provides personal insurance products and undertakes related reinsurance contracts in South Korea. The company offers pension/savings, whole life/term, cancer/health, dementia/nursing care, whole life/term, and retirement pension insurance products, as well as insurance and insurance policyholder credit loans. MIRAE ASSET Life Insurance Co., Ltd. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
